evidence.quote: participants indicated that the Committee was at or near the point at which it would be appropriate to slow the pace of policy easing.
Almost all participants judged that upside risks to the inflation outlook had increased.
Many participants noted that the Committee could hold the policy rate at a restrictive level, or ease policy more slowly, if inflation remained elevated
the likelihood that elevated inflation could be more persistent had increased.
recent data on economic activity and consumer spending in particular were, on balance, stronger than anticipated.
Participants judged that it was appropriate to continue the process of reducing the Federal Reserve's securities holdings.

parsed.rationale: Although the minutes describe a 25 bp cut, the discussion emphasizes slowing the pace of easing, increased upside inflation risks, and strong activity, with some participants favoring a hold. Runoff continues, so the net signal is a hawkish lean relative to the easing path.
